trials.claim: Lifetime access to SendFox with all future Lifetime Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to SendFox
- All future Lifetime Plan updates
- An AppSumo Original, created by the AppSumo team as a simple, affordable solution
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow the vendor to terminate or suspend access immediately for any reason whatsoever, which materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We may terminate or suspend access to our Service immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be terminated immediately for any reason, so it is not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: The Lifetime plan is exclusively available to customers who maintain an account contact size of up to 25,000 contacts.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is capped by a contact limit with suspension risk, contradicting unlimited lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Get lifetime access for $29, including 5,000 contacts and 300,000 total email sends.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states lifetime access is sold for $29 with stated limits.

exhibits.quote: great value love the lifetime deal. thanks for a great deal still can't believe it
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they received the lifetime deal and value it.

trials.reasoning: The vendor and a buyer both confirm the Lifetime plan includes 300,000 sends for one payment, and the prosecution exhibits do not directly deny that limit.

exhibits.quote: By use of the Service, you also agree to deliverability optimization of emails which may include reducing send volume from an account holder in order to comply with what we deem best sending practices on our Service.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can reduce send volume at its discretion, undermining the promised 300,000 sends.

exhibits.quote: We set up 20 email campaigns for Black Friday/Cyber Monday. Only 4 actually went out.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports most campaigns did not send, showing the send allowance is limited in practice.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime gets you 300,000 sends for one payment, which is years of newsletters at a typical sending pace.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms Lifetime plan includes 300,000 sends for one payment.

exhibits.quote: My plan includes up to 5,000 contacts and 300,000 email sends, which is plenty when you’re getting started.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms their plan includes 300,000 email sends.

trials.reasoning: The vendor and a buyer both confirm the plan includes 5,000 contacts; the terms about counting unsubscribed contacts do not contradict the stated 5,000-contact limit.

exhibits.quote: The contact count includes all contacts both subscribed and unsubscribed.
exhibits.argument: The 5,000 limit counts even unsubscribed contacts, making it smaller than advertised.

exhibits.quote: When a customer approaches the existing limits of their Service, they may be automatically upgraded to a new Service level that matches their increase in usage.
exhibits.argument: Exceeding limits triggers automatic upgrade, so the 5,000 cap can force paid changes.

exhibits.quote: Get lifetime access for $29, including 5,000 contacts and 300,000 total email sends.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the offer includes 5,000 contacts.

exhibits.quote: My plan includes up to 5,000 contacts and 300,000 email sends, which is plenty when you’re getting started.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms their plan includes up to 5,000 contacts.

trials.claim: All future Lifetime Plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote:
All future Lifetime Plan updates
- An AppSumo Original, created by the AppSumo team as a simple, affordable solution
trials.reasoning: A lifetime buyer confirms SendFox keeps updating and upgrading the interface at no extra cost for lifetime users, and the prosecution exhibits do not show a Lifetime Plan update being withheld.

exhibits.quote: The only way to turn off double opt-in, ia you guessed it... Upgrading to the empire plan.
exhibits.argument: Key functionality requires a paid Empire upgrade, so not all updates are included for Lifetime.

exhibits.quote: The HTML editor was a key feature we relied on to create branded, professional-looking emails.
exhibits.argument: Buyer lost HTML editor access after a change, showing Lifetime updates removed features.

exhibits.quote: Sendfox keeps updating and upgrading the interface, giving more options to personalize at no extra cost for lifetime users.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms lifetime users receive updates and upgrades at no extra cost.

trials.reasoning: The 7-day term applies to monthly subscriptions, and Lifetime refunds are deferred to the deal site's terms, so no exhibit shown confirms or directly contradicts a 60-day guarantee for this deal.

exhibits.quote: Money Back Guarantee Refunds will be provided up to 7 days after the original purchase of a monthly subscription if SendFox does not meet expectations.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms state only 7 days for monthly purchases, contradicting a 60-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: For customers availing the Lifetime plan, adherence to the terms of the respective website through which the Lifetime deal was acquired (e.g., appsumo.com) is essential.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime refunds are deferred to another site's terms, so SendFox does not itself guarantee 60 days.

trials.claimQuote:
### License Tier 1: $29 (was $480)

trials.reasoning: Exhibits confirm the $29 lifetime price, but none shown supports the claimed $480 regular price.

exhibits.quote: Start free. Own it forever for $29. Pay monthly only when you're big enough to need it.
exhibits.argument: Vendor sells lifetime ownership for $29 with no $480 regular price shown, undermining the was-price claim.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to adjust pricing for our service or any components thereof in any manner and at any time as we may determine in our sole and absolute discretion.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change pricing at any time, so the $29 versus $480 comparison is not fixed.
